integrity: Every profile and perfect matching through the claimed boundary is exhausted. Stability is computed independently in two ways, rank-maximality is cross-checked by lexicographic and steep-base objectives, and sex equality is cross-checked using aggregate rank sums and equivalent preferred-alternative counts.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for complete strict Stable Marriage markets through three agents per side. No claim is made about larger markets, ties, incomplete lists, or alternative profile conventions.
title: Sharp three-by-three conflict layer for rank-maximal and sex-equal stable marriage
